overview_description.description: Procurics is a cloud-based procurement and spend management platform designed to help businesses streamline purchasing, vendor management, and expense control processes. The platform enables organizations to manage requisitions, purchase orders, supplier relationships, approvals, and spend analysis from a centralized system.
